description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for a performance testing suite related to the 'lazy_init-name-hash' functionality. It runs various tests, including comparison of hashmaps generated in single-threaded and multi-threaded modes, and calibration steps to determine the number of entries and rounds for testing.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Executes the testing tool 'lazy-init-name-hash' with specified flags.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specified description and commands.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets prerequisites for the test environment.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two output files for differences.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of all tests.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs performance tests with specified descriptions and commands.
